# Glossary review: Spanish (`es`)

*Written by `python scripts/intake/glossary_tool.py record`; `check` compares it with a fresh run. Do not edit it.*

Glossary version `1.0.0-draft`. These are DRAFTS until you approve them.

## What to check

1. Is the canonical form the word a trader of this language really uses for the term?
2. Are the other accepted spellings words a trader would also type (a short form, a plural, a verb form)? A question that contains any of them is recognised as containing the term.
3. Does any spelling also mean something else in this language? It would mark an unrelated question.
4. Do the texts below read naturally, say what the English says, and keep each `{name}` placeholder?

## Fixed replies, instant prompts and reason texts

| Key | English | Spanish |
| --- | --- | --- |
| intake.refusal.not_signed_in | Please sign in to ask the AI analyst. | Inicie sesión para preguntar al analista de IA. |
| intake.refusal.tier_required | The AI analyst is part of the Pro plan. | El analista de IA forma parte del plan Pro. |
| intake.refusal.thread_invalid | This conversation is not available. Start a new one about gold (XAUUSD). | Esta conversación no está disponible. Inicie una nueva sobre el oro (XAUUSD). |
| intake.refusal.profile_not_set | Confirm your trading profile first. | Confirme primero su perfil de trading. |
| intake.refusal.quota_insufficient | Your AI analyst allowance is used up for now. Please try again later. | Su cupo del analista de IA se ha agotado por ahora. Inténtelo de nuevo más tarde. |
| intake.refusal.feature_unavailable | The AI analyst is not available yet. | El analista de IA aún no está disponible. |
| intake.refusal.question_empty | Type a question about gold (XAUUSD) first. | Escriba primero una pregunta sobre el oro (XAUUSD). |
| intake.refusal.question_too_long | Your question is too long. Please keep it to {limit} characters or fewer. | Su pregunta es demasiado larga. Limítela a {limit} caracteres como máximo. |
| intake.refusal.understanding_failed | That question could not be read just now. Please try again. | No se pudo leer esa pregunta ahora. Inténtelo de nuevo. |
| intake.refusal.out_of_scope | This analyst covers gold (XAUUSD) on the M5 and M15 charts only. Ask about those. | Este analista solo cubre el oro (XAUUSD) en los gráficos M5 y M15. Pregunte sobre ellos. |
| intake.instant.m5 | Explain the current M5 chart | Explique el gráfico M5 actual |
| intake.instant.m15 | Explain the current M15 chart | Explique el gráfico M15 actual |
| intake.reason.data_stale | The market data is out of date, so this sensor has no usable reading. | Los datos del mercado están desactualizados, así que este sensor no tiene una lectura utilizable. |
| intake.reason.retuning | The chart indicator is being re-tuned, so this reading is less reliable for now. | El indicador del gráfico se está reajustando, así que esta lectura es menos fiable por ahora. |
| intake.reason.no_setting | No indicator setting is available for this timeframe, so this sensor cannot read it. | No hay ajuste de indicador para este marco temporal, así que este sensor no puede leerlo. |
| intake.reason.detection_mismatch | The indicator found in the data does not match its setting, so treat this reading with caution. | El indicador detectado en los datos no coincide con su ajuste, así que tome esta lectura con cautela. |
| intake.reason.no_stats_at_slot | The statistics for this moment are not available yet, so this reading is out of date. | Las estadísticas de este momento aún no están disponibles, así que esta lectura está desactualizada. |
| intake.reason.containment_low | The price is not staying inside the channel well enough for a reliable reading. | El precio no se mantiene lo bastante dentro del canal para una lectura fiable. |
| intake.reason.insufficient_bars | There are not enough closed bars yet for a reliable reading. | Todavía no hay suficientes velas cerradas para una lectura fiable. |
| intake.reason.discontinuity | The bars have gaps or are out of order, so this reading cannot be trusted. | Las velas tienen huecos o están desordenadas, así que esta lectura no es de fiar. |
| intake.reason.sanity_failed | The channel values are impossible, so this reading cannot be trusted. | Los valores del canal son imposibles, así que esta lectura no es de fiar. |
| intake.reason.upstream_cautionary | {sensor} is cautionary, so this reading is cautionary too. | {sensor} requiere precaución, así que esta lectura también. |
| intake.reason.upstream_unavailable | {sensor} has no valid reading, so this one is unavailable. | {sensor} no tiene una lectura válida, así que esta no está disponible. |
| intake.reason.upstream_stale | {sensor} is out of date, so this one is too. | {sensor} está desactualizado, así que esta lectura también. |
| intake.reason.mcd0_defect_m5 | The M5 channel does not fit the price well enough, so readings that use it are cautionary. | El canal M5 no se ajusta lo bastante al precio, así que las lecturas que lo usan requieren precaución. |
| intake.reason.mcd0_defect_m15 | The M15 channel does not fit the price well enough, so readings that use it are cautionary. | El canal M15 no se ajusta lo bastante al precio, así que las lecturas que lo usan requieren precaución. |
| intake.reason.evaluator_error | This sensor hit an unexpected error and has no reading right now. | Este sensor tuvo un error inesperado y ahora no tiene lectura. |
| intake.reason.modifier_caution | Another sensor adds caution to this reading: {state}. | Otro sensor añade precaución a esta lectura: {state}. |

## Sign-off

Read the tables above, then edit `approval.json` in this folder: set `status` to `APPROVED`, `approved_by` to your name and `approved_on` to the date (YYYY-MM-DD). It holds the SHA-256 of the content you read, so a later change to it puts this area back to PENDING (`python scripts/intake/glossary_tool.py record`). Then run `record` once more so the forms of Spanish are marked `approved` in the glossary.
